_note: Variety pools for Module D (plan_specs.js). heroes adds planner/prompt metadata on top of config/heroines.json (which stays the asset-id authority). palettes lists hero/enemy color PAIRS that read against each other; the planner only pairs a hero with enemies whose palette forms an allowed pair with that hero's palette. enemies = prompt-mode opponent pool (no ref sheet). Environments are dark-fantasy biomes; desc_en feeds the EN storyboard templates, desc_zh the ZH video templates.

vesta.desc_zh: 火红长发，黑铁鎏金符文战甲，火焰光晕环绕周身，面颊符文发光，以烈焰为武器（火焰冲击波、熔岩爆炸、烈焰横扫）
vesta.casual_opening_en: an ordinary moment in the wilds — walking a lonely path through wind-worn, ember-lit ruins
vesta.casual_opening_zh: 荒野中的寻常一刻——独自走在风蚀余烬的废墟小径上

morta.desc_zh: 暗影死神形态：暗影恶魔战甲，手持燃烧幽绿鬼火的长柄镰刀，周身缠绕翻涌暗影与幽绿火光，以横扫的镰刀弧光与暗影爆发为武器
morta.casual_opening_en: an ordinary modern moment — a schoolgirl walking a neon-lit night-city street or waiting on a subway platform, an everyday urban commute
morta.casual_opening_zh: 现代都市的寻常一刻——身着校服走在霓虹夜色的街头、或伫立于地铁站台，如日常通勤

aurora.desc_zh: 圣辉圣骑士形态：天使板甲与流光巨剑，背后展开由发光光丝构成的羽翼，周身环绕金色晨曦光辉，以圣光爆发与巨剑弧光为武器
aurora.casual_opening_en: an ordinary moment in a sacred place — walking the quiet halls of an ancient temple
aurora.casual_opening_zh: 圣地中的寻常一刻——缓步走过古老神殿的静谧殿廊

vyra.desc_zh: 野性部落龙骑士少女，脏辫缠骨珠与龙牙，脸颊龙鳞部落纹身、眼部黑色战纹，铜色飞行护目镜，身着粗犷兽皮鳞甲，骑乘一头巨大的战龙；龙喉喷吐余烬橙色龙焰

fixed_environment.desc_en: a vast naval battle on a stormy sea, a fleet of tall warships with towering masts and sails at dusk
fixed_environment.desc_zh: 风暴海面上的大规模海战，黄昏时分扬帆林立的高大战船舰队

fixed_environment.desc_en: a storm-dark sky above an erupting volcanic massif, colossal burning debris, molten boulders and shockwaves hurled up from a titanic eruption below
fixed_environment.desc_zh: 风暴笼罩的天空，下方是喷发的巨型火山群，巨大的燃烧碎块、熔岩巨石与冲击波自下方的剧烈喷发中冲天抛起

transformation_reveal_v2._note: PIVOT SPINE (2026-07-26). Roster-less fresh-hero 15s single-clip transformation reveal. Prompt assembled by tools/assemble_transform_prompt.py (Ollama slot-fill). Does NOT use heroines/palettes/opponents/storyboard — planned by plan_specs' dedicated transform_v2 branch, NOT the hero x style candidate loop (assembler_style excludes it there). NEVER routes to atlas (hailuo/dreamina only).

_retired_styles_note: transformation_closeup (closeup_variant) RETIRED from rotation 2026-06-30 (owner human-rejection): the arc opened AND closed on an extreme close-up — the opening macro detail was great but the clip lost quality toward the end and the closing close-up didn't match the start detail, breaking the loop/continuity. Definition + templates kept in config/fight_styles.json for history; flagged in output/hypotheses.jsonl.
_experiment_variants_note: OPTIONAL flywheel treatments the nightly planner RANDOMLY samples onto eligible videos (NOT applied by default, NOT to all). Each: rate=per-video probability, styles=eligible fight_styles (must carry the template slot), hypothesis_id+delivery_check are stamped so the run is tracked + manipulation-checked AND so human-review outcomes (incl. REJECTION) are attributable to the treatment. plan_specs --reversal-beat forces it on for deliberate runs. See make_video REVERSAL_CLAUSE + fingerprint reversal_beat + analyst variant_review.

delivery_check.question: Around the middle of the clip, does the hero briefly appear to be LOSING or overwhelmed (struck down, knocked to a knee, or her power dimming) before turning it around into the finisher?

environments.desc_en: wind-eroded ember wasteland, drifting ash and glowing embers in the dust
environments.desc_zh: 荒芜的余烬战场，风蚀荒漠，余烬与扬尘飞舞

environments.desc_en: frozen fjord at dusk, cracked ice sheets underfoot, jagged glacial cliffs
environments.desc_zh: 黄昏的冰封峡湾，脚下冰面龟裂，两侧嶙峋冰崖耸立

environments.desc_en: half-drowned ancient temple, dark waist-deep water, broken sinking pillars
environments.desc_zh: 半淹没的远古神殿，深暗的及腰积水与断裂下沉的石柱

environments.desc_en: obsidian canyon, glassy black rock walls, faint rivers of magma glowing below
environments.desc_zh: 黑曜石峡谷，乌黑如镜的岩壁，谷底隐隐流淌发光的岩浆

environments.desc_en: storm-wracked highland plateau, lightning splitting the sky, rain-lashed stone
environments.desc_zh: 雷暴肆虐的高原，闪电撕裂天空，暴雨抽打嶙峋岩石

environments.desc_en: ruined overgrown city, collapsed towers swallowed by vines and deep moss
environments.desc_zh: 被藤蔓与厚苔吞没的废墟之城，坍塌的高塔残骸

environments.desc_en: endless salt flats at night, mirror-thin water reflecting a vast starfield
environments.desc_zh: 夜晚一望无际的盐沼，薄水如镜，倒映浩瀚星空

environments.desc_en: black-sand volcanic shore, glowing lava fissures meeting a dark crashing sea
environments.desc_zh: 黑沙火山海岸，炽红熔岩裂隙没入翻涌的暗色海浪

environments.desc_en: colossal ancient library interior, towering bookshelf cliffs, dust floating in god-rays
environments.desc_zh: 巨大无比的远古图书馆内部，高耸如崖的书架，光柱中浮尘飞舞

environments.desc_en: shattered floating sky islands above a cloud sea, hanging chains and falling waterfalls
environments.desc_zh: 云海之上的破碎浮空岛，悬垂的巨大锁链与坠落的瀑布

enemies.desc_en: humanoid of black obsidian and churning shadow, narrow violet glowing eye-slits
enemies.desc_zh: 黑曜石与翻涌暗影构成的人形，细长眼缝透出紫色冷光

enemies.desc_en: swordsman of pale glacial ice and white frost-mist, ice-blue glowing eyes, frost trailing off its blade
enemies.desc_zh: 由淡蓝冰晶与白色寒雾构成的剑士，双眼透出冰蓝寒光，刃上拖曳霜雾

enemies.desc_en: long-limbed stalker of pale bone and luminous toxic-green spores, joints seeping toxic-green glow
enemies.desc_zh: 由苍白骨骼与荧光毒孢构成的瘦长猎手，关节缝隙渗出毒绿荧光

enemies.desc_en: knight in polished crimson-and-silver plate, scarlet energy seeping from the seams
enemies.desc_zh: 身披猩红与银白抛光铠甲的骑士，甲缝间渗出猩红能量

enemies.desc_en: colossus construct of pale marble veined with molten gold, molten-gold light flowing between its carved runes
enemies.desc_zh: 由淡色大理石铸成、流淌熔金脉络的傀儡巨像，符文刻痕间流淌熔金光芒

enemies.desc_en: wraith of roiling pale-silver storm cloud and white lightning, white-hot arcs coiling around its limbs
enemies.desc_zh: 由翻涌的银白雷云与白色闪电构成的幽影，四肢缠绕炽白电弧

enemies.desc_en: a colossal abyssal sea-titan rising from the deep — a barnacled leviathan of black stone and drowned bronze, vast tentacled limbs, glowing abyssal teal-blue cracks and eyes
enemies.desc_zh: 自深海崛起的庞大深渊海中巨灵——遍布藤壶的黑石与沉铜之躯，巨大的触臂，透出深蓝海渊光芒的裂隙与双眼
